head2: Here are the 5 worth your time

items.title: Run ChatGPT ads from Ad Manager
items.why: OpenAI joins Meta, Google and LinkedIn in Ad Manager. You need a connected OpenAI Ads account.

items.title: Share meeting recordings safely
items.why: Share Meeting Room recordings by link, with passcodes, expiry dates and download controls.

items.title: AI agents that work on a schedule
items.why: Routines let Managed Agents run recurring tasks, as often as hourly, and pause for approval on sensitive steps.

items.title: Rentals you can book in the Client Portal
items.why: Clients can book and cancel rentals in the new Client Portal, on accounts with Rentals turned on.

items.title: Workflow logs now keep 60 days
items.why: Execution logs doubled from 30 days, with a CSV export for agency admins and users.
